title: Methods of grading and visual classification of muscovite mica splittings
clause_1_scope: This standard covers the methods of size classification of muscovite mica splittings by standard commercial grades and specifies the maximum allowable physical defects for each grade. It is applicable to commercially available natural muscovite mica splittings, irrespective of the basic colour of the mica or its source.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Specification for zinc oxide for paints Second Revision

clause_3_terminology: Methods of grading and visual classification of muscovite mica splittings

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
